items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Nick Rongetti used to be at the bar there during the war years, and he was a piano player

ctx.x: And was always known as Dixieland or Nixiland, they used to call it -- Nick Rongetti used to be at the bar there during the war years, and he was a piano player, he always had two pianos going. Hank Duncan worked there also, a great pianist -- he used to play double piano, and nobody knows this, but he used to go out on the road when Fats Waller had two pianos. Nobody knows. That's why Hank adopted a lot of Fats Waller songs. He was the solo pianist there.
